skills.name: Lead from the Front
skills.description: Alberic is courageous and loves to be in the thick of battle, inspiring the rest of the army to valorous deeds.

skills.name: Coastal Expansion
skills.description: Alberic's navy helps shipbuilding materials and provisions get to coastal settlements, allowing them to prosper.

skills.name: Shipping Lanes
skills.description: Bordeleaux's sea routes were once used by the Elven colonists; now they serve Alberic's people.

skills.name: Appoint Reeves
skills.description: The duke appoints administrators amongst the smallfolk, who are familiar with local issues.

skills.name: Blessed Water
skills.description: "By this blessed water, prepare us for your service, dear Lady."

skills.name: The Army of the King
skills.description: "The king without a sword? The land without a king!"

skills.name: Beloved Son of Bretonnia
skills.description: "You will be the land, and the land will be you. If you fail, the land will perish."

skills.description: Knights, peasants, and everyone in between feel honour-bound to follow Repanse to death or glory.

effects.description: Armour-piercing weapon damage: %+n for Infantry units

skills.name: Eternal Errantry War
skills.description: If you wish to find an enemy, you need merely throw a stone.

skills.name: Virtue of Empathy
skills.description: Led by noble example, peasants fight longer and harder lest their Lord be dishonoured.
